answer: Each identity needs a sponsor locking a 50-credit nectar bond in the vine registry. A sponsor may back at most three identities, and a new sponsor must show a non-transferable relic credential of prior work, at a 200-credit onboarding cost. The k-th fake costs 50 credits, plus 200 when it opens a branch, at k = 1, 4, 7 and so on; 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors, locking 116,800 credits. A panel audits quota and relic age each epoch, and slashes a branch when one backed identity proves fake, so a rented sponsor ring loses its bonds. An honest agent joins an existing branch and pays 50 once.
